verdict.rationale: Tilled docs mention viewing a merchant's 'payout speed' in the Dashboard, implying some configurability of payout timing per merchant, but there is no documentation of specific schedule options (daily/weekly/monthly/manual) or instant payouts to cards/real-time rails. Missing for 10: explicit schedule configuration options, instant/real-time payout rail support, per-seller granularity beyond a single 'speed' setting, and any independent corroboration.
